# Agents waiting (Herdr mod)

> A Herdr app mod: a dialog that lists the agents that need you or have finished, with a one-line preview of what they asked and how long they have waited, then every other agent grouped by space. Plain JavaScript, one folder (mods/attention-picker), one key (ctrl-shift-a, bound to mod.open:attention-picker). It uses no network and no exec (this mod's own policy, checked by scripts/validate.mjs; Herdr itself does not sandbox mods); it reads terminal screen text with `hc read` while open and keeps none of it.

This is a mod for the Herdr desktop app, not a library or a web app. Install by copying mods/attention-picker/ into the Herdr app home's mods/ folder and merging keys.json. Tell the person what the mod reaches before installing (see AGENTS.md, "Installing it for a person"). Never edit the live Herdr home while developing: Herdr reloads on every save. Tested on Herdr 0.1.12 only. The original mod ran in the author's Herdr on macOS; later changes passed `herdr-app check` and unit tests but have not been watched in a live window, and nothing was run on Linux or Windows (see AGENTS.md, "Verification status").

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/AGENTS.md): install, adapt, test and edit safely; the compatibility contract; Herdr gotchas; claim-to-source map.
- [RECIPE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/RECIPE.md): the brief in Herdr's sharing format (what you see, how it behaves, built from, watch out, done when).
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/README.md): what it is, install in one command, keys, privacy, troubleshooting, uninstall.

## Mod files

- [mods/attention-picker/main.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/mods/attention-picker/main.js): the view and its constants; the header comment is the contract.
- [mods/attention-picker/logic.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/mods/attention-picker/logic.js): pure helpers (durations, names, sorts, status-time precedence, selection).
- [mods/attention-picker/ask.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/mods/attention-picker/ask.js): pure, screen text to the one-line preview.
- [mods/attention-picker/mod.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/mods/attention-picker/mod.json): overlay description (dialog, width 640).
- [keys.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-agents-waiting/main/keys.json): the key to merge into the person's keys.

## Contract that must not break

- Folder name attention-picker; prop `search` (false = keys-only variant, otherwise the search box shows).
- Shared keys: `attention.sort` (read and write: recent, oldest, space), `agents.since` (read only, wins over local tracking), `space.colors` (read only).
- Command run: `agent.focus` with the agent's terminal address.

## Checks

- `npm test` (runs `node --test`, Node 22+; never `node --test tests/`), `node scripts/validate.mjs`, `node scripts/privacy-scan.mjs`, `node scripts/check-docs.mjs`; `node scripts/check-local.mjs` runs them all.
- CI is defined in scripts/ci.workflow.yml (Linux, Windows and macOS, each on Node 22 and 24); it is enabled when the owner installs it and has not run yet.
- `herdr-app check <absolute path to mods/attention-picker>` (needs the desktop app; renders once only).
